**Rule:** the game's UI never cuts text with "…", never hides an element because it does not fit, and never adds an
arbitrary width or line limit to make a layout work. Text that does not fit wraps and the row grows. Every agent checks
its own visible work in the running game through Godot MCP (gopeak on the Mac) before committing, and also takes the
game's own TR/EN frames.

**Why:** On 2026-10-28 Erdem reviewed the UE frames. He wrote that "abuk subuk kısıtlama vs veya … kabul edilemez" and
that agents must validate their work visually with MCP. What triggered it:
- c7's finding that the left column "can only shrink to 280 px because a long name breaks";
- card names cut with "…" after two lines.

**How to apply:**
- Brief every UI agent with N4 read strictly: no `…`, no clipping, no hidden overflow.
- Have every UI agent run a sweep for `text_overrun_behavior`, `clip_text`, `max_lines`, `visible_characters` and
  fixed-width cuts.
- Count-collapsing displays such as "+{n} kart" are a design choice. They go to Erdem as frames, and nobody removes them
  on their own.
- Before forwarding any frame to Erdem, check it for truncation myself.

=== godot-mcp-runtime-verification
---
name: godot-mcp-runtime-verification
description: How to do runtime + visual (screenshot) verification of Project Unicorn via the Godot MCP — headless vs windowed gotchas
metadata: 
  node_type: memory
  type: reference
  originSessionId: ba0916de-0dda-4870-a4b5-b6602a9038bd
  modified: 2026-08-21T13:54:21.346Z
---

Runtime-verifying Project Unicorn (Godot 4.6) through the Godot MCP:

**Logic / console checks:** `mcp__godot__editor-run` launches the project **headless** (`--headless -d`) — fine for driving systems + reading `mcp__godot__editor-debug-output` (the `[SalesSystem]/[EventManager]/[VH]` prints), but it has **no rendered viewport, so `capture-screenshot` returns nothing useful**. A throwaway harness scene that drives systems in `_ready()` and prints PASS/FAIL is the reliable pattern; do NOT call `get_tree().quit()` or the process dies before you can read output — leave it alive and `editor-stop` after.

**Screenshots / visual checks:** you must launch a **windowed** instance yourself, NOT via editor-run. Use PowerShell `Start-Process` with the args as a SINGLE quoted string (the project path contains a space — `…\project steam\…` — so a PowerShell array splits it and Godot aborts with "Invalid project path"):
`Start-Process godot.exe -ArgumentList '--path "C:\Users\erdem\Desktop\project steam\project-unicorn" res://scenes/test/<harness>.tscn'`
The runtime addon then prints "Server listening on port 7777" and `capture-screenshot` / `call-runtime-method` / `inspect-runtime-tree` target it.

**Port 7777 is single-instance:** only one game process binds the runtime addon. If another instance (a leftover playtest, or editor-run's headless one) holds it, the MCP runtime tools talk to the WRONG process (you'll see a different scene tree / stale save). Kill strays (`Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "name like '%godot%'"` → `Stop-Process`) before launching your windowed harness. The runtime tools (groups `runtime` + `testing`) are deferred — load via `tool-catalog`/ToolSearch.

**Reaching game state without onboarding:** a harness scene can `GameState.initialize_run(payload)` then mount `res://scenes/main/GameShell.tscn` and call `ProductSystem.start_build("ai_assistant", ["ai_assistant_chat","ai_assistant_memory"], "")`. Expose `vh_*` methods on the harness root and trigger them via `call-runtime-method` between screenshots. Note `initialize_run` does NOT reset `flags` or `CustomerRegistry`; `product_tab` re-routes only on `day_advanced`/sales signals (not `build_phase_changed`). `--skip-onboarding` / F12 also jump to GameShell (debug builds).

**Runtime bridge input/arg limitations (2026-07-13, verified the hard way):** `call-runtime-method` args CANNOT satisfy typed GDScript params — int/bool/Dictionary all fail (Dictionary throws an explicit "Cannot convert argument 1 from String to Dictionary" at the `callv` boundary; method not run). Only ARGLESS methods are reliable; for parameterized debug paths add an argless relay on a Node (statics unreachable — nodePath required), e.g. `GameShell.debug_force_month_extreme()`. **EXCEPTION — single String args DO marshal:** `call-runtime-method /root/EventBus emit_signal "<signal_name>"` works (returns 0) and fires the signal, so the reliable way to verify a debug HOTKEY whose handler lives in the main loop is to emit its EventBus signal directly rather than inject the key — mandatory for SHIFT-modified or F-key shortcuts (2026-07-14: verified the Shift+F4 onboarding-retrigger this way; `inject-key` both mis-maps F-key names AND silently drops the shift modifier, so it can't reproduce Shift+F4 at all). `inject-key`: key NAMES don't parse ("F5" → keycode 5, "Space" → error) — use NUMERIC keycodes (F1=4194332…F11=4194342, Space=32, Enter=4194309); the `shift` param is NOT honored on the synthesized event (Shift+F11 arrives shiftless). Injected keys reach `_input` handlers (F-keys work) but NOT the GUI focus dispatch (Enter won't activate a focused button). `inject-mouse-click` lands at (0,0) regardless of x/y. Bottom line: drive UI verification via argless runtime methods + screenshots; reserve injected keys for raw `_input` hotkeys only.

**New `class_name` scripts need a cache rebuild before ANY run (2026-07-14):** after creating scripts that declare `class_name X` (or referencing them via preload in an already-loaded script), a headless/MCP run fails with `Parse Error: Identifier "X" not declared in the current scope` / `Could not find type "X"` even though the code is correct — the global class cache (`.godot/global_script_class_cache.cfg`) is stale. Fix: run `--headless --import` once (prints `update_scripts_classes | X`), which registers the new globals; then the run parses clean. The `--import` pass ALSO imports new texture assets (e.g. renamed `.webp`) so runtime `load(path)` resolves. Do it after adding each batch of new `class_name` files, before editor-run.

**Pure-CLI headless smoke (no MCP, fastest for the `endgame_smoke` suite) (2026-07-14):** the console build is at `C:\Users\erdem\Desktop\Godot_v4.6.2-stable_win64_console.exe`. Loop cases from PowerShell capturing stdout via the pipe (`$out = & $exe --headless --path $proj --endgame-smoke=<case>`; then `$out | Select-String "SMOKE (PASS|FAIL)"`). Two gotchas: (1) a NEW `class_name` needs a scan first — `& $exe --headless --path $proj --editor --quit` registers it (prints `update_scripts_classes | X`), same effect as `--import`; without it every case fails `Identifier "X" not declared`. (2) `main.gd`'s smoke path historically `return`ed WITHOUT quitting (the "left ALIVE" note in `endgame_smoke.gd` is for MCP editor-run reading the live log), so a CLI run **hung** and file-redirected stdout never flushed. FIX now in `main.gd`: after `run_case`, `if _smoke_case_on_cmdline(): get_tree().quit()` — quits only when the arg is on the actual command line (CLI), leaves the MCP/`ProjectSettings.main_args` path alive. So CLI runs now self-quit + flush; the pipe capture works.

**No-MCP windowed screenshot (2026-07-14):** run WINDOWED (omit `--headless`) with a debug cmdline flag whose handler calls `get_viewport().get_texture().get_image().save_png("user://x.png")` then `get_tree().quit()`; read the PNG from `C:\Users\erdem\AppData\Roaming\Godot\app_userdata\Project Unicorn\`. Sidesteps the port-7777 MCP bridge entirely. Used to verify the Spec 6 Term Sheet Table (idle + post-push states) and the Finance>Yatırım relocation. Debug-gate such flags (`OS.is_debug_build()` + explicit flag) and remove one-off screenshot scaffolding after; a persistent debug HOTKEY (e.g. Shift+F6 opens the table) is fine to keep.

**Köprünün gerçek sınırları — 4 canlı run'la yeniden ölçüldü (2026-08-06 audit'i):** (1) **`inject-mouse-click` TAMAMEN KIRIK** — MCP sunucusu `x`/`y` gönderiyor, addon `position` parametresini okuyor (`mcp_runtime_autoload.gd:361`), yani her tık (0,0)'a düşüyor ve yanıt bunu `position:[0,0]` diye geri söylüyor. Tıklama gerektiren her doğrulama için **OS seviyesinde tık** yaz: PowerShell + `user32.dll` (`SetForegroundWindow`+`SetCursorPos`+`mouse_event`), viewport (1920×1080) → client rect ölçekleyerek; pencereyi `MainWindowTitle -notmatch 'Yöneticisi'` ile bul (Proje Yöneticisi penceresi de "Godot" adıyla görünür). (2) **int argümanlar HÂLÂ marshal olmuyor** (eski not doğru): `resolve_choice(id, 0)` gibi typed-int çağrılar sessizce `null` döner — ve bu `null` bir void çağrının `null`'ından AYIRT EDİLEMEZ, o yüzden "çalıştı" sanmak kolay (bu audit'te bir kez yanlış pozitif verdi). String argümanlar çalışır ama **TIRNAKSIZ** gönder: `["mvp_shipped","true"]` doğru, `["\"mvp_shipped\"","true"]` anahtarı tırnak karakterleriyle birlikte saklar ve oyun bayrağı hiç görmez. (3) **Her argüman String olarak varır** — `set_flag("mvp_shipped","true")` bayrağı String yapar; sistemler truthiness ile okuduğu için çalışır AMA event koşulları `bool(x)==bool(y)` ile karşılaştırdığı için ÇAKILIR (frank_intro 23 gün boyunca hiç ateşlenmedi; `main._seed_theme_surface()` gerçek bool yazınca ilk tick'te ateşlendi). Gerçek-tipli dünya için argsız fixture seam'lerini çağır. (4) **Argsız altın seam'ler** (`/root/Main` üstünde, hepsi tek çağrı): `_seed_run_reproducible()` (initialize_run + seed 424242), `_seed_theme_surface()` (shipped B2B dünya + 3 müşteri + 2 prospect, gerçek bool'larla), `_seed_hr_roster()` (5 kişilik kadro). Modal kapatma: `MentorIntroModal._on_continue_pressed`, `MonthSummaryModal._dismiss`. (5) **Durum okuma tek seam:** `GameState.get_run_ledger()` = 33 anahtarlık tam digest (day/cash/mrr/brand/rep/customers/employees/phase/sayaçlar). `get()`/`get_indexed()` native olduğu için GÜVENİLMEZ (null döner) — script tanımlı getter kullan. (6) **`run_seed` hiçbir yolla okunamıyor** (ledger'da yok, get() kırık, hiç print edilmiyor) — audit'in S2-40 bulgusu; organik run'ların tohumu kaydedilemez, yalnız `_seed_run_reproducible` ile sabitlenmiş run tekrarlanabilir. (7) Speed tuşları `inject-key` ile SAYISAL keycode: Space=32, 1-4 = 49-52 (F-tuşları 4194332+). ModalLayer boşken çalışır (game_shell Guard 2).

**`-s` script-mode (SceneTree) bulguları (2026-08-07, localization probe):** (1) `--path` ile `-s` çalıştırınca autoload'lar YÜKLENİR ama `_ready`'leri senin `_initialize`'ından SONRA (ilk frame'de) koşar — autoload'un kurduğu state'i `_initialize`'da okuma, frame 2'de oku. (2) `-s` mutlak yol kabul eder (res:// şart değil — scratchpad'den koşabilirsin). (3) **Control auto-translate proje bağlamında ÇALIŞIR, projesiz `-s`'te ÇALIŞMAZ** (AUTO_TRANSLATE_MODE_ALWAYS bile) — lokalizasyon davranışını asla projesiz modda test etme, yanlış negatif alırsın. (4) Headless'ta "ekranda ne render oldu" iddiası için Label min-width'ini literal ikiz-label'larla karşılaştır — shaped text'i ölçer, screenshot gerektirmez.

**`-s` script-mode, tur 2 — GÖRSEL harness olarak kullanmak (2026-08-21, Frank verify):** `-s` ile PROJE DOSYASINA HİÇ DOKUNMADAN gerçek modal render'ı + 1920×1080 PNG alınabiliyor; `main.gd:592-600`'deki `--b2b-shot` deyimini birebir kopyala (fabrika `GameEvent` üret → `EventModal.tscn` instantiate → `populate()` → 2 frame + 0.35s → `root.get_texture().get_image().save_png()`). Bu, "hiçbir şeyi düzeltme" kuralı altında shot bayrağı OLMAYAN yüzeyleri çekmenin yolu. **ÜÇ TUZAK:** (1) **`-s` script'i autoload GLOBAL'leri kaydolmadan ÖNCE derlenir** — dosyanın tepesinde `preload("...EventModal.tscn")` ya da gövdede `GameState`/`ProductSystem` gibi bir tanımlayıcı geçerse koşu `Compile Error: Identifier not found: Localization` ile ölür. Her şeyi çalışma zamanına ertele: `load()`, `root.get_node("/root/GameState")`, `SomeScript.call("_static_fn", ...)`. Alt çizgili static'ler dışarıdan çağrılabilir. (2) **Pencere `mode=3` (kenarlıksız tam ekran) doğuyor** — `DisplayServer.window_set_mode(WINDOWED)` sonra `window_set_size` + `root.content_scale_*`; sırayı bozarsan boyut sessizce yutulur. (3) **Locale'i `TranslationServer.set_locale()` ile zorla, ASLA `Localization.set_language()` ile** — ikincisi Settings'e yazar ve oyuncunun tercihini değiştirir.

**Label.text ≠ ekranda ne yazıyor (2026-08-21):** Godot'un Control auto-translate'i anahtarı ÇİZİM anında çözer, `.text`'i yeniden yazmaz. Sahneye gömülü anahtar taşıyan Label'lar (`HuntTab.tscn:37 text="HUNT_PAGE_TITLE"`) bir ağaç-gezen text dump'ında HAM ANAHTAR olarak görünür ama ekranda doğru çevrilmiş çıkar. Dump'a bakıp "eksik anahtar" bulgusu yazma — PNG'ye bak. (Bu tam olarak üç yanlış bulgu üretip PNG ile öldürüldü.)

**`--run-log=<preset>:<days>` `:sim` OLMADAN ASILIYOR (2026-08-21):** `main.gd:147` yalnız `:sim` son ekinde ya da iki nokta içermeyen spec'te `quit()` çağırıyor; `full_run:730` bütün ledger'ı basar ve süreç canlı kalır. Her zaman `:sim` ver.

=== partial-staging-shared-tree
---
name: partial-staging-shared-tree
description: How to commit only your own work when a parallel session is editing the same files, and how to prove the resulting tree is real
metadata:
  type: feedback
---

Erdem 2026-08-21: "stage only my own files — the parallel session's work is not mine to commit."
When the shared files are shared *inside*, whole-file staging cannot honour that. The working
method:

1. Classify every changed file as mine / theirs / mixed by reading the diffs, not by filename.
2. For mixed files, dump `git diff -U1` split at `^@@`, keep only my hunk indices, reassemble
   with the original file header, and `git apply --cached --recount`. Index-only — the working
   tree is never touched, so the other session keeps its edits.
3. **Re-derive the hunk indices immediately before staging.** They shift whenever either session
   edits the file, including your own later fixes.

**The verification that matters:** the suite runs against the WORKING TREE (mine + theirs), so a
partial-stage commit is unverified by construction. Extract the index into a scratch directory
with `git checkout-index -a -f --prefix=<tmp>/` — that is byte-for-byte the commit tree — then
import and actually run it there. On 2026-08-21 that pass was green (10 cases + loc_residue) and
turned "the hunks look independent" into a measurement.

Cheap pre-checks that caught nothing but would have: grep the *unstaged remainder* for your own
vocabulary (must be 0 hits), and grep the *staged* version of a shared file for THEIR symbols
(must be 0) — an orphan reference is the failure mode partial staging creates.

**Limit (2026-10-18, Faz B paralel partisi):** parça düzeyinde ayırma yalnız adımlar birbirinin SATIRINA dokunmadıysa
çalışır. Paralel adımlardan biri öbürünün yeni fonksiyonunu yeniden adlandırdı ya da aynı satırı değiştirdiyse ara ağaç
hiç var olmamıştır; parçayı seçmek onu kuramaz, ancak elle uydurulur ve koşulmamış olur. O durumda parti tek commit'tir
(mesajda adım başına paragraf); per-step commit isteniyorsa adımlar aynı dosyalarda seri koşulmalı.

=== strings-csv-surgery
---
name: strings-csv-surgery
description: "strings.csv has no single quoting convention, so edit it by byte-span splice, never by rewrite; plus the token rules the integrity gate enforces"
metadata: 
  node_type: memory
  type: reference
  originSessionId: 954101b2-26e4-4348-828b-cca7aeee9b88
  modified: 2026-08-23T18:00:59.101Z
---

`localization/strings.csv` (1800+ keys, TR canonical) **cannot be safely round-tripped by a CSV
writer.** Its quoting is inconsistent row to row: some rows quote a field that needs no quoting,
some do not quote a sibling that does. A `csv.reader` → `csv.writer` pass with any single
quoting policy rewrites ~126 unrelated physical lines while claiming to change one key.

**Edit it by splicing byte spans.** Parse records with a quote-aware scanner that records each
record's `(start, end, key)`, then replace only the spans you mean to touch and leave every other
byte alone. Apply edits back-to-front so earlier offsets stay valid; an insert-after-anchor at
`end` and a replace of `(start, end)` compose correctly in that order. Verify by re-parsing and

=== feedback-no-truncation-mcp-validation
---
name: feedback-no-truncation-mcp-validation
description: "Erdem 2026-10-28: 'abuk subuk kısıtlama veya … kabul edilemez' — UI must not truncate or hide content; agents must validate their own work visually via Godot MCP"
metadata:

---

**Rule:** the game's UI never cuts text with "…", never hides an element because it does not fit, and never adds an
arbitrary width or line limit to make a layout work. Text that does not fit wraps and the row grows. Every agent checks
its own visible work in the running game through Godot MCP (gopeak on the Mac) before committing, and also takes the
game's own TR/EN frames.

**Why:** On 2026-10-28 Erdem reviewed the UE frames. He wrote that "abuk subuk kısıtlama vs veya … kabul edilemez" and
that agents must validate their work visually with MCP. What triggered it:
- c7's finding that the left column "can only shrink to 280 px because a long name breaks";
- card names cut with "…" after two lines.

**How to apply:**
- Brief every UI agent with N4 read strictly: no `…`, no clipping, no hidden overflow.
- Have every UI agent run a sweep for `text_overrun_behavior`, `clip_text`, `max_lines`, `visible_characters` and
  fixed-width cuts.
- Count-collapsing displays such as "+{n} kart" are a design choice. They go to Erdem as frames, and nobody removes them
  on their own.
- Before forwarding any frame to Erdem, check it for truncation myself.

=== partial-staging-shared-tree
---
name: partial-staging-shared-tree
description: How to commit only your own work when a parallel session is editing the same files, and how to prove the resulting tree is real
metadata:
  type: feedback
---

Erdem 2026-08-21: "stage only my own files — the parallel session's work is not mine to commit."
When the shared files are shared *inside*, whole-file staging cannot honour that. The working
method:

1. Classify every changed file as mine / theirs / mixed by reading the diffs, not by filename.
2. For mixed files, dump `git diff -U1` split at `^@@`, keep only my hunk indices, reassemble
   with the original file header, and `git apply --cached --recount`. Index-only — the working
   tree is never touched, so the other session keeps its edits.
3. **Re-derive the hunk indices immediately before staging.** They shift whenever either session
   edits the file, including your own later fixes.

**The verification that matters:** the suite runs against the WORKING TREE (mine + theirs), so a
partial-stage commit is unverified by construction. Extract the index into a scratch directory
with `git checkout-index -a -f --prefix=<tmp>/` — that is byte-for-byte the commit tree — then
import and actually run it there. On 2026-08-21 that pass was green (10 cases + loc_residue) and
turned "the hunks look independent" into a measurement.

Cheap pre-checks that caught nothing but would have: grep the *unstaged remainder* for your own
vocabulary (must be 0 hits), and grep the *staged* version of a shared file for THEIR symbols
(must be 0) — an orphan reference is the failure mode partial staging creates.

**Limit (2026-10-18, Faz B paralel partisi):** parça düzeyinde ayırma yalnız adımlar birbirinin SATIRINA dokunmadıysa
çalışır. Paralel adımlardan biri öbürünün yeni fonksiyonunu yeniden adlandırdı ya da aynı satırı değiştirdiyse ara ağaç
hiç var olmamıştır; parçayı seçmek onu kuramaz, ancak elle uydurulur ve koşulmamış olur. O durumda parti tek commit'tir
(mesajda adım başına paragraf); per-step commit isteniyorsa adımlar aynı dosyalarda seri koşulmalı.

Related: [[concurrent-session-hazard]] · [[single-folder-single-remote-rule]] ·

**Rule:** the game's UI never cuts text with "…", never hides an element because it does not fit, and never adds an
arbitrary width or line limit to make a layout work. Text that does not fit wraps and the row grows. Every agent checks
its own visible work in the running game through Godot MCP (gopeak on the Mac) before committing, and also takes the
game's own TR/EN frames.

that agents must validate their work visually with MCP. What triggered it:

=== partial-staging-shared-tree
---
name: partial-staging-shared-tree
description: How to commit only your own work when a parallel session is editing the same files, and how to prove the resulting tree is real
metadata:
  type: feedback
---

Erdem 2026-08-21: "stage only my own files — the parallel session's work is not mine to commit."
When the shared files are shared *inside*, whole-file staging cannot honour that. The working
method:

1. Classify every changed file as mine / theirs / mixed by reading the diffs, not by filename.
2. For mixed files, dump `git diff -U1` split at `^@@`, keep only my hunk indices, reassemble
   with the original file header, and `git apply --cached --recount`. Index-only — the working
   tree is never touched, so the other session keeps its edits.
3. **Re-derive the hunk indices immediately before staging.** They shift whenever either session
   edits the file, including your own later fixes.

**The verification that matters:** the suite runs against the WORKING TREE (mine + theirs), so a
partial-stage commit is unverified by construction. Extract the index into a scratch directory
with `git checkout-index -a -f --prefix=<tmp>/` — that is byte-for-byte the commit tree — then
import and actually run it there. On 2026-08-21 that pass was green (10 cases + loc_residue) and
turned "the hunks look independent" into a measurement.

Cheap pre-checks that caught nothing but would have: grep the *unstaged remainder* for your own
vocabulary (must be 0 hits), and grep the *staged* version of a shared file for THEIR symbols
(must be 0) — an orphan reference is the failure mode partial staging creates.

**Limit (2026-10-18, Faz B paralel partisi):** parça düzeyinde ayırma yalnız adımlar birbirinin SATIRINA dokunmadıysa
çalışır. Paralel adımlardan biri öbürünün yeni fonksiyonunu yeniden adlandırdı ya da aynı satırı değiştirdiyse ara ağaç
hiç var olmamıştır; parçayı seçmek onu kuramaz, ancak elle uydurulur ve koşulmamış olur. O durumda parti tek commit'tir
(mesajda adım başına paragraf); per-step commit isteniyorsa adımlar aynı dosyalarda seri koşulmalı.

=== strings-csv-surgery
---
name: strings-csv-surgery
description: "strings.csv has no single quoting convention, so edit it by byte-span splice, never by rewrite; plus the token rules the integrity gate enforces"
metadata: 
  node_type: memory
  type: reference
  originSessionId: 954101b2-26e4-4348-828b-cca7aeee9b88
  modified: 2026-08-23T18:00:59.101Z
---

`localization/strings.csv` (1800+ keys, TR canonical) **cannot be safely round-tripped by a CSV
writer.** Its quoting is inconsistent row to row: some rows quote a field that needs no quoting,
some do not quote a sibling that does. A `csv.reader` → `csv.writer` pass with any single
quoting policy rewrites ~126 unrelated physical lines while claiming to change one key.

**Edit it by splicing byte spans.** Parse records with a quote-aware scanner that records each
record's `(start, end, key)`, then replace only the spans you mean to touch and leave every other
byte alone. Apply edits back-to-front so earlier offsets stay valid; an insert-after-anchor at
`end` and a replace of `(start, end)` compose correctly in that order. Verify by re-parsing and
diffing the key→value map: everything you did not name must come back byte-identical.

Format facts: header `keys,tr,en`, exactly 3 columns, UTF-8 **no BOM**, **LF only**, embedded
newlines are literal LF inside a quoted field (24 rows have them), trailing newline present.

**Those 24 embedded-newline rows are also a DELETION trap, measured 2026-08-23.** A sweep that
splits the raw text on newlines and drops lines whose first field matches a prefix removes only
the FIRST physical line of a multi-line record and leaves its continuation lines behind as
orphans. The
parse then breaks from that row onward and the key count collapses silently — 1929 → 939 in the
instance that caught it, while the file lost only 55 lines and `wc -l` looked fine. `loc_residue`
is what screams (`fakekey=17`); `loc_csv_integrity` also fails but *after* the damage. Delete
whole RECORDS with a quote-aware parse, never physical lines — this is the same reason the
memory above says splice spans rather than rewrite.

**What `loc_csv_integrity` enforces** (a smoke case in `endgame_smoke.gd`, not a standalone
script) — the two that bite:

- Placeholder tokens must match `[a-z_]+` and the **TR and EN token sets must be identical**.
  A Turkish-named token like `{yatırımcı}` is not recognised as a token at all, so it trips the
  stray-brace count and would render on screen as literal `{yatırımcı}`. Authors write Turkish
  placeholder names; the build needs the ASCII one in both columns. See
  [[frank-v6-landing-pass]].
- Every key must resolve in both locales (`translate(k) != k`), no duplicates, no positional
  `%s`/`%d`.
- **Exactly 3 columns** — tightened 2026-08-21 after it shipped a bug. A TR value carrying an
  UNQUOTED COMMA splits into four fields: TR keeps only the fragment before the comma, the EN
  column receives TR's *second* fragment, and the real EN falls into a fourth column nobody
  reads. Both columns are non-empty and token-free, so every other assertion passes and an
  English player sees a Turkish sentence on screen. The gate said `row.size() < 3`; it now says
  `!= 3`. **When you author a value containing a comma, quote it** — nothing else will tell you.

The companion gate is `scripts/debug/loc_residue.gd`, run as
`godot --headless --path . -s res://scripts/debug/loc_residue.gd` (exit 0 = clean, prints the
key count). Both are named in CLAUDE.md as "proof is a command, not a claim".

**Windows/Python gotcha:** stdout defaults to cp1254 and will die on `→` or `·`. Set
`PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8`, and write results to a file with an explicit `encoding="utf-8"`
rather than printing them. MSYS-style `/c/...` paths do not work in Windows Python — pass
`C:/...`.

Godot 4.6'da `.godot/` derleme önbelleği iki ayrı tuzak barındırıyor ve ikisi de "kod hatası" gibi okunuyor. 2026-08-17 ODA mühürlü sanat turunda ikisi de tek oturumda ısırdı.

**1. Kaynak PNG'yi üzerine yazmak yetmez — Godot bayat `.ctex`'i servis etmeye devam eder.** Sekiz yeni 3840×2160 katman kurdum, sabitleri yeni ölçümlere göre güncelledim ve dokuz shot aldım: telefon kadrajda YOKTU. Sebep kod değildi — atlas region'ı x 1976'ya taşınmıştı, önbellekteki doku ise telefonu hâlâ x 2721'de tutuyordu, yani region tamamen ŞEFFAF alanı örnekliyordu. Teşhis tek satır: kaynak `.png` mtime'ı ile `.godot/imported/<ad>.png-*.ctex` mtime'ını karşılaştır (benimkiler 7 gün ayrıydı). Çözüm `godot --headless --path . --import`.

**2. Ama `--import` de bir sonraki koşuyu bozuyor.** `global_script_class_cache.cfg`'yi EKSİK yazıyor (77 sınıf yerine 76; alfabetik ilk giren `AngelRoundSystem` düşmüş). Hemen sonraki koşu `Parse Error: Identifier "AngelRoundSystem" not declared` → `Compile Error: Failed to compile depended scripts` → `Failed to instantiate an autoload` (`event_manager`, `time_manager`) → Nil erişim hatalarıyla ölüyor: tek koşuda 34 hata, hiçbiri gerçek. O koşu çıkarken önbelleği ONARIYOR; 2. ve sonraki koşular temiz (üst üste üç kez ölçtüm).

**Why:** İkisi de sessiz. Birincisinde screenshot'lar ÜRETİLİYOR ve düzgün görünüyor — yalnız yanlış sanatla, yani contact sheet'i yönetmene yollarsan onaylanan şey ölçtüğün şey olmuyor. İkincisinde gate'li bataryanın hata sayacı ateşleniyor ve gerçek bir regresyon sanıyorsun; daha kötüsü, o pencerede üretilen kareler autoload'ları ÖLÜ hâlde render edilmiş oluyor (bu turda yedi kareyi yeniden çekmek gerekti).

**How to apply:**
- Sanat kurduktan sonraki sıra kesin: **`--import` → bir tek ATILACAK ısınma koşusu → ancak sonra gate'li shot/smoke bataryası.**
- Bataryayı koşmadan önce doğrula: `stat -c%y` ile kaynak vs `.ctex`, ve `grep -c '"class": &' .godot/global_script_class_cache.cfg` sayısını projedeki `grep -rhoE '^class_name' scripts/ | wc -l` ile karşılaştır. Eşit değilse önbellek yarım.
- `Identifier "X" not declared` + `Failed to instantiate an autoload` ikilisini gördüğünde **önce önbelleği şüphelen, kendi diff'ini değil** — özellikle X senin dokunduğun hiçbir şeyle ilgili değilse. Aynı imza paralel oturum `class_name` eklediğinde de çıkıyor ([[concurrent-session-hazard]]).
- Bu, `SMOKE PASS` yalanının bir başka kaynağı: autoload düşse bile ona dokunmayan case PASS basar ([[smoke-verification-cadence]]).

**3. ÜÇÜNCÜ TETİK (2026-08-25, Ar-Ge turu): ÖLDÜRÜLEN bir batarya arkasında Godot süreci bırakıyor ve o süreç bir sonraki bataryayla önbellek üstünde yarışıyor.** Tam bataryayı yarıda kesip (TaskStop) kod düzeltip yeniden koştum; koşu dört HR case'ini `SCRIPT ERROR: Parse Error: Identifier "EventGate" not declared` + `Failed to load script "res://scripts/ui/oda/oda_view.gd"` ile düşürdü — 72-108 hata satırı. **Dördü de TEK BAŞINA koşunca PASS.** `EventGate` benim dokunduğum hiçbir şeyle ilgili değildi ve önbellekte de mevcuttu; suçlu, öldürülen koşudan kalan süreçlerdi. name: godot-mcp-runtime-verification
description: How to do runtime + visual (screenshot) verification of Project Unicorn via the Godot MCP — headless vs windowed gotchas
metadata: 
  node_type: memory
  type: reference
  originSessionId: ba0916de-0dda-4870-a4b5-b6602a9038bd
  modified: 2026-08-21T13:54:21.346Z
---

Runtime-verifying Project Unicorn (Godot 4.6) through the Godot MCP:

**Logic / console checks:** `mcp__godot__editor-run` launches the project **headless** (`--headless -d`) — fine for driving systems + reading `mcp__godot__editor-debug-output` (the `[SalesSystem]/[EventManager]/[VH]` prints), but it has **no rendered viewport, so `capture-screenshot` returns nothing useful**. A throwaway harness scene that drives systems in `_ready()` and prints PASS/FAIL is the reliable pattern; do NOT call `get_tree().quit()` or the process dies before you can read output — leave it alive and `editor-stop` after.

**Screenshots / visual checks:** you must launch a **windowed** instance yourself, NOT via editor-run. Use PowerShell `Start-Process` with the args as a SINGLE quoted string (the project path contains a space — `…\project steam\…` — so a PowerShell array splits it and Godot aborts with "Invalid project path"):
`Start-Process godot.exe -ArgumentList '--path "C:\Users\erdem\Desktop\project steam\project-unicorn" res://scenes/test/<harness>.tscn'`
The runtime addon then prints "Server listening on port 7777" and `capture-screenshot` / `call-runtime-method` / `inspect-runtime-tree` target it.

**Port 7777 is single-instance:** only one game process binds the runtime addon. If another instance (a leftover playtest, or editor-run's headless one) holds it, the MCP runtime tools talk to the WRONG process (you'll see a different scene tree / stale save). Kill strays (`Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "name like '%godot%'"` → `Stop-Process`) before launching your windowed harness. The runtime tools (groups `runtime` + `testing`) are deferred — load via `tool-catalog`/ToolSearch.

**Reaching game state without onboarding:** a harness scene can `GameState.initialize_run(payload)` then mount `res://scenes/main/GameShell.tscn` and call `ProductSystem.start_build("ai_assistant", ["ai_assistant_chat","ai_assistant_memory"], "")`. Expose `vh_*` methods on the harness root and trigger them via `call-runtime-method` between screenshots. Note `initialize_run` does NOT reset `flags` or `CustomerRegistry`; `product_tab` re-routes only on `day_advanced`/sales signals (not `build_phase_changed`). `--skip-onboarding` / F12 also jump to GameShell (debug builds).

**Runtime bridge input/arg limitations (2026-07-13, verified the hard way):** `call-runtime-method` args CANNOT satisfy typed GDScript params — int/bool/Dictionary all fail (Dictionary throws an explicit "Cannot convert argument 1 from String to Dictionary" at the `callv` boundary; method not run). Only ARGLESS methods are reliable; for parameterized debug paths add an argless relay on a Node (statics unreachable — nodePath required), e.g. `GameShell.debug_force_month_extreme()`. **EXCEPTION — single String args DO marshal:** `call-runtime-method /root/EventBus emit_signal "<signal_name>"` works (returns 0) and fires the signal, so the reliable way to verify a debug HOTKEY whose handler lives in the main loop is to emit its EventBus signal directly rather than inject the key — mandatory for SHIFT-modified or F-key shortcuts (2026-07-14: verified the Shift+F4 onboarding-retrigger this way; `inject-key` both mis-maps F-key names AND silently drops the shift modifier, so it can't reproduce Shift+F4 at all). `inject-key`: key NAMES don't parse ("F5" → keycode 5, "Space" → error) — use NUMERIC keycodes (F1=4194332…F11=4194342, Space=32, Enter=4194309); the `shift` param is NOT honored on the synthesized event (Shift+F11 arrives shiftless). Injected keys reach `_input` handlers (F-keys work) but NOT the GUI focus dispatch (Enter won't activate a focused button). `inject-mouse-click` lands at (0,0) regardless of x/y. Bottom line: drive UI verification via argless runtime methods + screenshots; reserve injected keys for raw `_input` hotkeys only.

**New `class_name` scripts need a cache rebuild before ANY run (2026-07-14):** after creating scripts that declare `class_name X` (or referencing them via preload in an already-loaded script), a headless/MCP run fails with `Parse Error: Identifier "X" not declared in the current scope` / `Could not find type "X"` even though the code is correct — the global class cache (`.godot/global_script_class_cache.cfg`) is stale. Fix: run `--headless --import` once (prints `update_scripts_classes | X`), which registers the new globals; then the run parses clean. The `--import` pass ALSO imports new texture assets (e.g. renamed `.webp`) so runtime `load(path)` resolves. Do it after adding each batch of new `class_name` files, before editor-run.

**Pure-CLI headless smoke (no MCP, fastest for the `endgame_smoke` suite) (2

... [3669 characters truncated] ...

(null döner) — script tanımlı getter kullan. (6) **`run_seed` hiçbir yolla okunamıyor** (ledger'da yok, get() kırık, hiç print edilmiyor) — audit'in S2-40 bulgusu; organik run'ların tohumu kaydedilemez, yalnız `_seed_run_reproducible` ile sabitlenmiş run tekrarlanabilir. (7) Speed tuşları `inject-key` ile SAYISAL keycode: Space=32, 1-4 = 49-52 (F-tuşları 4194332+). ModalLayer boşken çalışır (game_shell Guard 2).

**`-s` script-mode (SceneTree) bulguları (2026-08-07, localization probe):** (1) `--path` ile `-s` çalıştırınca autoload'lar YÜKLENİR ama `_ready`'leri senin `_initialize`'ından SONRA (ilk frame'de) koşar — autoload'un kurduğu state'i `_initialize`'da okuma, frame 2'de oku. (2) `-s` mutlak yol kabul eder (res:// şart değil — scratchpad'den koşabilirsin). (3) **Control auto-translate proje bağlamında ÇALIŞIR, projesiz `-s`'te ÇALIŞMAZ** (AUTO_TRANSLATE_MODE_ALWAYS bile) — lokalizasyon davranışını asla projesiz modda test etme, yanlış negatif alırsın. (4) Headless'ta "ekranda ne render oldu" iddiası için Label min-width'ini literal ikiz-label'larla karşılaştır — shaped text'i ölçer, screenshot gerektirmez.

**`-s` script-mode, tur 2 — GÖRSEL harness olarak kullanmak (2026-08-21, Frank verify):** `-s` ile PROJE DOSYASINA HİÇ DOKUNMADAN gerçek modal render'ı + 1920×1080 PNG alınabiliyor; `main.gd:592-600`'deki `--b2b-shot` deyimini birebir kopyala (fabrika `GameEvent` üret → `EventModal.tscn` instantiate → `populate()` → 2 frame + 0.35s → `root.get_texture().get_image().save_png()`). Bu, "hiçbir şeyi düzeltme" kuralı altında shot bayrağı OLMAYAN yüzeyleri çekmenin yolu. **ÜÇ TUZAK:** (1) **`-s` script'i autoload GLOBAL'leri kaydolmadan ÖNCE derlenir** — dosyanın tepesinde `preload("...EventModal.tscn")` ya da gövdede `GameState`/`ProductSystem` gibi bir tanımlayıcı geçerse koşu `Compile Error: Identifier not found: Localization` ile ölür. Her şeyi çalışma zamanına ertele: `load()`, `root.get_node("/root/GameState")`, `SomeScript.call("_static_fn", ...)`. Alt çizgili static'ler dışarıdan çağrılabilir. (2) **Pencere `mode=3` (kenarlıksız tam ekran) doğuyor** — `DisplayServer.window_set_mode(WINDOWED)` sonra `window_set_size` + `root.content_scale_*`; sırayı bozarsan boyut sessizce yutulur. (3) **Locale'i `TranslationServer.set_locale()` ile zorla, ASLA `Localization.set_language()` ile** — ikincisi Settings'e yazar ve oyuncunun tercihini değiştirir.

**Label.text ≠ ekranda ne yazıyor (2026-08-21):** Godot'un Control auto-translate'i anahtarı ÇİZİM anında çözer, `.text`'i yeniden yazmaz. Sahneye gömülü anahtar taşıyan Label'lar (`HuntTab.tscn:37 text="HUNT_PAGE_TITLE"`) bir ağaç-gezen text dump'ında HAM ANAHTAR olarak görünür ama ekranda doğru çevrilmiş çıkar. Dump'a bakıp "eksik anahtar" bulgusu yazma — PNG'ye bak. (Bu tam olarak üç yanlış bulgu üretip PNG ile öldürüldü.)

**`--run-log=<preset>:<days>` `:sim` OLMADAN ASILIYOR (2026-08-21):** `main.gd:147` yalnız `:sim` son ekinde ya da iki nokta içermeyen spec'te `quit()` çağırıyor; `full_run:730` bütün ledger'ı basar ve süreç canlı kalır. Her zaman `:sim` ver.

İlgili: [[project-unicorn-current-stage]], [[localization-tr-en-task]]

**Oynanabilir playtest turu 2026-10-07 (gopeak 2.4.0 ile yeniden ölçüldü):**
- **`inject-mouse-click` ARTIK ÇALIŞIYOR** (pozisyon doğru gidiyor); koordinat PENCERE pikselidir, tasarım
  koordinatı değil: 2560×1440 tam ekranda tasarım × 1,3333. `inject-mouse-motion` sonra press (`pressed:true`) +
  release (`pressed:false`) üçlüsü Button, CheckBox ve PanelContainer `gui_input` kartlarının hepsinde tutuyor.
- **OS seviyesinde girdi (SetCursorPos/mouse_event/SendKeys) YASAK — Erdem makinede oyun oynuyor olabilir.** Bu turda
  LoL ön plandayken OS tıkları onun oyununa gitti; ayrıca çok monitörde mutlak hareket olayı ana monitöre göre
  normalize olup yanlış yere düşüyor. Süreç içi enjeksiyon odağı çalmaz; tek yol o.
- `set-runtime-property` String özelliklerde (LineEdit.text) çalışır; TEK String argüman tipli parametreye de marshal

Runtime-verifying Project Unicorn (Godot 4.6) through the Godot MCP:

**Logic / console checks:** `mcp__godot__editor-run` launches the project **headless** (`--headless -d`) — fine for driving systems + reading `mcp__godot__editor-debug-output` (the `[SalesSystem]/[EventManager]/[VH]` prints), but it has **no rendered viewport, so `capture-screenshot` returns nothing useful**. A throwaway harness scene that drives systems in `_ready()` and prints PASS/FAIL is the reliable pattern; do NOT call `get_tree().quit()` or the process dies before you can read output — leave it alive and `editor-stop` after.

**Screenshots / visual checks:** you must launch a **windowed** instance yourself, NOT via editor-run. Use PowerShell `Start-Process` with the args as a SINGLE quoted string (the project path contains a space — `…\project steam\…` — so a PowerShell array splits it and Godot aborts with "Invalid project path"):
`Start-Process godot.exe -ArgumentList '--path "C:\Users\erdem\Desktop\project steam\project-unicorn" res://scenes/test/<harness>.tscn'`
The runtime addon then prints "Server listening on port 7777" and `capture-screenshot` / `call-runtime-method` / `inspect-runtime-tree` target it.

**Port 7777 is single-instance:** only one game process binds the runtime addon. If another instance (a leftover playtest, or editor-run's headless one) holds it, the MCP runtime tools talk to the WRONG process (you'll see a different scene tree / stale save). Kill strays (`Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "name like '%godot%'"` → `Stop-Process`) before launching your windowed harness. The runtime tools (groups `runtime` + `testing`) are deferred — load via `tool-catalog`/ToolSearch.

**Reaching game state without onboarding:** a harness scene can `GameState.initialize_run(payload)` then mount `res://scenes/main/GameShell.tscn` and call `ProductSystem.start_build("ai_assistant", ["ai_assistant_chat","ai_assistant_memory"], "")`. Expose `vh_*` methods on the harness root and trigger them via `call-runtime-method` between screenshots. Note `initialize_run` does NOT reset `flags` or `CustomerRegistry`; `product_tab` re-routes only on `day_advanced`/sales signals (not `build_phase_changed`). `--skip-onboarding` / F12 also jump to GameShell (debug builds).

**Runtime bridge input/arg limitations (2026-07-13, verified the hard way):** `call-runtime-method` args CANNOT satisfy typed GDScript params — int/bool/Dictionary all fail (Dictionary throws an explicit "Cannot convert argument 1 from String to Dictionary" at the `callv` boundary; method not run). Only ARGLESS methods are reliable; for parameterized debug paths add an argless relay on a Node (statics unreachable — nodePath required), e.g. `GameShell.debug_force_month_extreme()`. **EXCEPTION — single String args DO marshal:** `call-runtime-method /root/EventBus emit_signal "<signal_name>"` works (returns 0) and fires the signal, so the reliable way to verify a debug HOTKEY whose handler lives in the main loop is to emit its EventBus signal directly rather than inject the key — mandatory for SHIFT-modified or F-key shortcuts (2026-07-14: verified the Shift+F4 onboarding-retrigger this way; `inject-key` both mis-maps F-key names AND silently drops the shift modifier, so it can't reproduce Shift+F4 at all). `inject-key`: key NAMES don't parse ("F5" → keycode 5, "Space" → error) — use NUMERIC keycodes (F1=4194332…F11=4194342, Space=32, Enter=4194309); the `shift` param is NOT honored on the synthesized event (Shift+F11 arrives shiftless). Injected keys reach `_input` handlers (F-keys work) but NOT the GUI focus dispatch (Enter won't activate a focused button). `inject-mouse-click` lands at (0,0) regardless of x/y. Bottom line: drive UI verification via argless runtime methods + screenshots; reserve injected keys for raw `_input` hotkeys only.

**New `class_name` scripts need a cache rebuild before ANY run (2026-07-14):** after creating scripts that declare `class_name X` (or referencing them via preload in an already-loaded script), a headless/MCP run fails with `Parse Error: Identifier "X" not declared in the current scope` / `Could not find type "X"` even though the code is correct — the global class cache (`.godot/global_script_class_cache.cfg`) is stale. Fix: run `--headless --import` once (prints `update_scripts_classes | X`), which registers the new globals; then the run parses clean. The `--import` pass ALSO imports new texture assets (e.g. renamed `.webp`) so runtime `load(path)` resolves. Do it after adding each batch of new `class_name` files, before editor-run.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Sessiz PLANMS, sıkı hâli: sessiz kilidini alır; her koşudan önce makinede Godot süreci kalmadığını üç ardışık okumayla (5 sn arayla)
# doğrular; koşu sürerken başka bir Godot görülürse koşuyu kirli sayar ve yeniden koşar (koşu başına en çok 4 deneme).
# Usage: quiet_planms2.sh <etiket> <ad=ağaç/project-unicorn>... [REPS=n env]
. "$(dirname "$0")/env.sh"
tag="$1"; shift; out="$S/planms_$tag"; mkdir -p "$out"
until lock_take sessiz "planms $tag"; do sleep 10; done
trap 'lock_drop sessiz' EXIT
echo "sessiz alındı $(date +%T)"
godots() { local n; n=$(tasklist //FI "IMAGENAME eq Godot_v4.6.2-stable_win64_console.exe" //NH 2>/dev/null | grep -ci "godot"); echo "${n:-0}"; }
quiet() {
  local ok=0 t=0
  while [ $ok -lt 3 ]; do
    if [ "$(godots)" = 0 ]; then ok=$((ok+1)); else ok=0; fi
    t=$((t+1)); [ $t -gt 720 ] && { echo "QUIET TIMEOUT"; return 1; }
    sleep 5
  done
}
for spec in "$@"; do
  name="${spec%%=*}"; tree="${spec#*=}"
  for r in $(seq "${REPS:-2}"); do
    for try in 1 2 3 4; do
      quiet || exit 9
      d="$S/appdata_planms/$tag/$name$r"; mkdir -p "$d"

        --sprint-probe=hours=40:cards=2:ticks=60:team=50:market=b2b:planms=1 > "$out/$name$r.log" 2>&1 ) &
      pid=$!; dirty=0
      while kill -0 $pid 2>/dev/null; do [ "$(godots)" -gt 1 ] && dirty=1; sleep 2; done
      wait $pid; rc=$?
      if [ $dirty = 0 ]; then break; fi
      echo "-- $name run$r try$try kirli, yeniden"
    done
    echo "== $name run$r rc=$rc dirty=$dirty mismatch=$(grep -ac MISMATCH "$out/$name$r.log") ($(date +%T))"
    grep -a "PLANMS" "$out/$name$r.log" | sed 's/^SPRINTPROBE PLANMS|team=50|//' | grep -a 'screen'
  done
done

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Sessiz PLANMS, sıkı hâli: sessiz kilidini alır; her koşudan önce makinede Godot süreci kalmadığını üç ardışık okumayla (5 sn arayla)
# doğrular; koşu sürerken başka bir Godot görülürse koşuyu kirli sayar ve yeniden koşar (koşu başına en çok 4 deneme).
# Usage: quiet_planms2.sh <etiket> <ad=ağaç/project-unicorn>... [REPS=n env]
. "$(dirname "$0")/env.sh"
tag="$1"; shift; out="$S/planms_$tag"; mkdir -p "$out"
until lock_take sessiz "planms $tag"; do sleep 10; done
trap 'lock_drop sessiz' EXIT
echo "sessiz alındı $(date +%T)"
godots() { local n; n=$(tasklist //FI "IMAGENAME eq Godot_v4.6.2-stable_win64_console.exe" //NH 2>/dev/null | grep -ci "godot"); echo "${n:-0}"; }
quiet() {
  local ok=0 t=0
  while [ $ok -lt 3 ]; do
    if [ "$(godots)" = 0 ]; then ok=$((ok+1)); else ok=0; fi
    t=$((t+1)); [ $t -gt 720 ] && { echo "QUIET TIMEOUT"; return 1; }
    sleep 5
  done
}
for spec in "$@"; do
  name="${spec%%=*}"; tree="${spec#*=}"
  for r in $(seq "${REPS:-2}"); do
    for try in 1 2 3 4; do
      quiet || exit 9
      d="$S/appdata_planms/$tag/$name$r"; mkdir -p "$d"
      ( cd "$tree" && APPDATA="$(cygpath -w "$d")" "$GODOT" --headless --path . \
        --sprint-probe=hours=40:cards=2:ticks=60:team=50:market=b2b:planms=1 > "$out/$name$r.log" 2>&1 ) &
      pid=$!; dirty=0
      while kill -0 $pid 2>/dev/null; do [ "$(godots)" -gt 1 ] && dirty=1; sleep 2; done
      wait $pid; rc=$?
      if [ $dirty = 0 ]; then break; fi
      echo "-- $name run$r try$try kirli, yeniden"
    done
    echo "== $name run$r rc=$rc dirty=$dirty mismatch=$(grep -ac MISMATCH "$out/$name$r.log") ($(date +%T))"
    grep -a "PLANMS" "$out/$name$r.log" | sed 's/^SPRINTPROBE PLANMS|team=50|//' | grep -a 'screen'
  done
done

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ORTAK_CALISMA §3 adım 3, temalar: THEME_STAMP = HEAD + 1 (m_ ve g_ ağaçlarında), build_theme kapı kopyasında (g_<etiket>)
# koşar, theme_check iki temada; üretilen themes/*.tres ve assets/fonts/variations/*.tres bozulmamış m_<etiket>'e kopyalanır,
# kod haritası yeniden üretilir. HEAD'den farklı üretilmiş yollar stdout'un "GEN <yol>" satırlarıdır. Usage: theme_regen.sh <etiket>
. "$(dirname "$0")/env.sh"
tag="$1"; M="$S/m_$tag/project-unicorn"; G="$S/g_$tag/project-unicorn"; PFX=project-unicorn
head_stamp=$(cd "$R" && git show HEAD:$PFX/scripts/theme/ui_tokens.gd | sed -n 's/^const THEME_STAMP := \([0-9]*\).*/\1/p')
[ -n "$head_stamp" ] || { echo "THEME FAIL: HEAD stamp okunamadı"; exit 3; }
new=$((head_stamp + 1))
for t in "$M" "$G"; do
  sed -i "s/^const THEME_STAMP := [0-9]*/const THEME_STAMP := $new/" "$t/scripts/theme/ui_tokens.gd"
done
echo "stamp $head_stamp -> $new"
gd "th_$tag" "$G" --headless --path . -s res://scripts/theme/build_theme.gd > "$S/g_$tag/build_theme.log" 2>&1 || { echo "THEME FAIL: build_theme"; tail -5 "$S/g_$tag/build_theme.log"; exit 4; }

cd "$G" || exit 2
for f in themes/*.tres assets/fonts/variations/*.tres; do
  cmp -s "$f" "$M/$f" || { mkdir -p "$(dirname "$M/$f")"; cp "$f" "$M/$f"; }
  h=$(cd "$R" && git rev-parse -q --verify "HEAD:$PFX/$f")
  [ "$(cd "$R" && git hash-object --path="$PFX/$f" "$M/$f")" != "$h" ] && echo "GEN $f"
done

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ORTAK_CALISMA §3'ün tamamı: kapıyı bekle ve al → yeni HEAD'e birleştir → kapı kopyasında --import + ısınma + smoke →
# özel index'le commit → senkron → kapıyı bırak. Çakışma ya da kapı düşerse kilidi bırakır, commit etmez.
# Usage: land.sh <etiket> <değişen-liste> <silinen-liste|-> <mesaj> <smoke-liste dosyası|->
. "$(dirname "$0")/env.sh"
tag="$1"; changed="$2"; deleted="$3"; msg="$4"; cases="$5"
[ "$deleted" = - ] && deleted=""
[ -d "$K/ekran" ] && grep -q '^URUN_ARAYUZU' "$K/ekran/sahip" 2>/dev/null && { echo "ABORT: ekran kilidi bende, kapı istenmez"; exit 2; }
until lock_take kapi "$tag commit"; do sleep 3; done
trap 'lock_drop kapi; echo "kapı bırakıldı"' EXIT
echo "kapı alındı $(date +%T)"
cd "$R" || exit 2
old=$(git rev-parse HEAD); echo "HEAD $old"
bash "$S/bin/merge.sh" "$old" "$tag" "$changed" $deleted || { echo "STOP: birleştirme çakıştı"; exit 3; }
bash "$S/bin/gate_copy.sh" "$tag"
G="$S/g_$tag/project-unicorn"
if [ "${THEME:-0}" = 1 ]; then
  bash "$S/bin/theme_regen.sh" "$tag" > "$S/theme_$tag.txt" || { cat "$S/theme_$tag.txt"; echo "STOP: tema üretimi düştü"; exit 7; }
  grep -v '^GEN ' "$S/theme_$tag.txt"
  { cat "$changed"; sed -n 's/^GEN //p' "$S/theme_$tag.txt"; } > "$S/changed_$tag.full"; changed="$S/changed_$tag.full"
fi
if [ "$cases" != - ]; then
  P=10 bash "$S/bin/smoke.sh" "$G" "land_$tag" @"$cases" | tail -5
  pass=$(grep -c 'SMOKE PASS' "$S/smoke_land_$tag/summary.txt"); all=$(grep -c . "$cases")
  [ "$pass" = "$all" ] || { echo "STOP: kapı smoke'u düştü ($pass/$all)"; exit 4; }
fi
[ "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$old" ] || { echo "STOP: HEAD kıpırdadı, yeniden koş"; exit 5; }
bash "$S/bin/commit.sh" "$tag" "$old" "$msg" "$changed" $deleted || { echo "STOP: commit.sh düştü"; exit 6; }
echo "LANDED $(git rev-parse --short HEAD) $(date +%T)"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ORTAK_CALISMA §3 adım 2-3: yeni HEAD'in taze dışa aktarımına kendi değişikliklerimi üç yollu birleştirir.
# Taban = $S/base (kopyanın tabanı), bizimki = $S/work, onlarınki = yeni HEAD. Çıktı $S/m_<etiket>/project-unicorn (bozulmamış),
# üretilmiş kod haritası orada yeniden üretilir. Usage: merge.sh <yeni HEAD> <etiket> <değişen-liste dosyası> [<silinen-liste dosyası>]
# Listeler project-unicorn/'a göre yol taşır (satır başına bir yol). Çakışmada 1 ile çıkar; çakışan dosyada işaretler kalır.
. "$(dirname "$0")/env.sh"
head="$1"; tag="$2"; changed="$3"; deleted="${4:-}"
B="${BASE:-$S/base/project-unicorn}"; W="${WORK:-$S/work/project-unicorn}"; M="$S/m_$tag/project-unicorn"
bash "$S/bin/export.sh" "m_$tag" "$head" >/dev/null || exit 2
GEN="docs/kod_haritasi/DIZIN.md docs/kod_haritasi/SEMBOLLER.tsv docs/kod_haritasi/KALITE.md docs/EVENT_SIGNAL_MANIFEST.md docs/content/events_draft/_vocabulary.md"
conf=0
while read -r f; do
  [ -z "$f" ] && continue
  case " $GEN " in *" $f "*) echo "GENERATED-IN-LIST $f (çıkar)"; conf=1; continue ;; esac
  case "$f" in themes/*.tres|assets/fonts/variations/*.tres) echo "GENERATED-IN-LIST $f (temayı merged ağaçta üret)"; conf=1; continue ;; esac
  if [ ! -e "$B/$f" ]; then
    if [ -e "$M/$f" ] && ! cmp -s "$M/$f" "$W/$f"; then echo "BOTH-ADDED $f"; conf=1; fi
    mkdir -p "$(dirname "$M/$f")"; cp "$W/$f" "$M/$f"; echo "new   $f"; continue
  fi
  if [ ! -e "$M/$f" ]; then echo "THEY-DELETED $f"; conf=1; continue; fi
  if cmp -s "$B/$f" "$M/$f"; then cp "$W/$f" "$M/$f"; echo "take  $f"; continue; fi

# Çakışan hunk'ları satır içinde, sözcük düzeyinde üç yollu birleştirir: taban satırı, onların satırı (HEAD), bizim satırımız.
# Her çakışmada iki tarafın satır sayısı tabandakiyle eşleşmeli; sözcük düzeyinde değişiklikler çakışmazsa birleştirir, çakışırsa
# dosyayı yazmaz ve çakışan satırı gösterir. Usage: python linemerge.py <birleşik dosya> <taban dosya> <onlar> <biz>
import difflib
import re
import sys

merged_p, base_p, theirs_p, ours_p = sys.argv[1:5]
rd = lambda p: open(p, encoding='utf-8', newline='').read()
merged, base, theirs, ours = rd(merged_p), rd(base_p).split('\n'), rd(theirs_p).split('\n'), rd(ours_p).split('\n')
TOK = re.compile(r'\s+|[^\s]+')


def merge_line(b, t, o):
    if t == o:
        return t
    if t == b:
        return o
    if o == b:
        return t
    bt, tt, ot = TOK.findall(b), TOK.findall(t), TOK.findall(o)
    def edits(x):
        return [op for op in difflib.SequenceMatcher(None, bt, x, autojunk=False).get_opcodes() if op[0] != 'equal']
    et, eo = edits(tt), edits(ot)
    for _, i1, i2, _, _ in et:
        for _, k1, k2, _, _ in eo:
            if max(i1, k1) < min(i2, k2) or (i1 == i2 == k1 == k2):
                return None
    out, i = [], 0
    allops = sorted([(i1, i2, tt[j1:j2]) for _, i1, i2, j1, j2 in et] + [(i1, i2, ot[j1:j2]) for _, i1, i2, j1, j2 in eo])
    for i1, i2, rep in allops:
        out += bt[i:i1] + rep
        i = i2
    return ''.join(out + bt[i:])


def find_block(lines, block):
    for s in range(len(lines) - len(block) + 1):
        if lines[s:s + len(block)] == block:
            return s
    return -1


pat = re.compile(r'^<<<<<<< [^\n]*\n(.*?)^=======\n(.*?)^>>>>>>> [^\n]*\n', re.S | re.M)
out, pos, ok = [], 0, True
for m in pat.finditer(merged):
    t_lines, o_lines = m.group(1).split('\n')[:-1], m.group(2).split('\n')[:-1]
    ts, os_ = find_block(theirs, t_lines), find_block(ours, o_lines)
    # Taban satırları: bizim taraftaki hunk'ın tabandaki karşılığı, aynı uzunlukta ve sözcük benzerliği en yüksek pencere.
    best, bs = -1.0, -1
    for s in range(len(base) - len(o_lines) + 1):
        r = sum(difflib.SequenceMatcher(None, base[s + k], o_lines[k]).quick_ratio() for k in range(len(o_lines)))
        if r > best:
            best, bs = r, s
    if len(t_lines) != len(o_lines) or ts < 0 or os_ < 0 or bs < 0:
        print('SHAPE', len(t_lines), len(o_lines)); ok = False; break
    res = []
    for k in range(len(o_lines)):
        line = merge_line(base[bs + k], t_lines[k], o_lines[k])
        if line is None:
            print('WORD-CONFLICT line', k, '\n  base:', base[bs + k][:200], '\n  them:', t_lines[k][:200], '\n  ours:', o_lines[k][:200])
            ok = False
            break
        res.append(line)
    if not ok:
        break
    out.append(merged[pos:m.start()] + '\n'.join(res) + '\n')
    pos = m.end()
if ok:
    open(merged_p, 'w', encoding='utf-8', newline='').write(''.join(out) + merged[pos:])
    print('merged', len(out), 'hunks')
else:
    sys.exit(1)

# Çakışan hunk'ları satır içinde, sözcük düzeyinde üç yollu birleştirir: taban satırı, onların satırı (HEAD), bizim satırımız.
# Her çakışmada iki tarafın satır sayısı tabandakiyle eşleşmeli; sözcük düzeyinde değişiklikler çakışmazsa birleştirir, çakışırsa
# dosyayı yazmaz ve çakışan satırı gösterir. Usage: python linemerge.py <birleşik dosya> <taban dosya> <onlar> <biz>
import difflib
import re
import sys

merged_p, base_p, theirs_p, ours_p = sys.argv[1:5]
rd = lambda p: open(p, encoding='utf-8', newline='').read()
merged, base, theirs, ours = rd(merged_p), rd(base_p).split('\n'), rd(theirs_p).split('\n'), rd(ours_p).split('\n')
TOK = re.compile(r'\s+|[^\s]+')


def merge_line(b, t, o):
    if t == o:
        return t
    if t == b:
        return o
    if o == b:
        return t
    bt, tt, ot = TOK.findall(b), TOK.findall(t), TOK.findall(o)
    def edits(x):
        return [op for op in difflib.SequenceMatcher(None, bt, x, autojunk=False).get_opcodes() if op[0] != 'equal']
    et, eo = edits(tt), edits(ot)
    for _, i1, i2, _, _ in et:
        for _, k1, k2, _, _ in eo:
            if max(i1, k1) < min(i2, k2) or (i1 == i2 == k1 == k2):
                return None
    out, i = [], 0
    allops = sorted([(i1, i2, tt[j1:j2]) for _, i1, i2, j1, j2 in et] + [(i1, i2, ot[j1:j2]) for _, i1, i2, j1, j2 in eo])
    for i1, i2, rep in allops:
        out += bt[i:i1] + rep
        i = i2
    return ''.join(out + bt[i:])


def find_block(lines, block):
    for s in range(len(lines) - len(block) + 1):
        if lines[s:s + len(block)] == block:
            return s
    return -1


pat = re.compile(r'^<<<<<<< [^\n]*\n(.*?)^=======\n(.*?)^>>>>>>> [^\n]*\n', re.S | re.M)
out, pos, ok = [], 0, True
for m in pat.finditer(merged):
    t_lines, o_lines = m.group(1).split('\n')[:-1], m.group(2).split('\n')[:-1]
    ts, os_ = find_block(theirs, t_lines), find_block(ours, o_lines)
    # Taban satırları: bizim taraftaki hunk'ın tabandaki karşılığı, aynı uzunlukta ve sözcük benzerliği en yüksek pencere.
    best, bs = -1.0, -1
    for s in range(len(base) - len(o_lines) + 1):
        r = sum(difflib.SequenceMatcher(None, base[s + k], o_lines[k]).quick_ratio() for k in range(len(o_lines)))
        if r > best:
            best, bs = r, s
    if len(t_lines) != len(o_lines) or ts < 0 or os_ < 0 or bs < 0:
        print('SHAPE', len(t_lines), len(o_lines)); ok = False; break
    res = []
    for k in range(len(o_lines)):
        line = merge_line(base[bs + k], t_lines[k], o_lines[k])
        if line is None:
            print('WORD-CONFLICT line', k, '\n  base:', base[bs + k][:200], '\n  them:', t_lines[k][:200], '\n  ours:', o_lines[k][:200])
            ok = False
            break
        res.append(line)
    if not ok:
        break
    out.append(merged[pos:m.start()] + '\n'.join(res) + '\n')
    pos = m.end()
if ok:
    open(merged_p, 'w', encoding='utf-8', newline='').write(''.join(out) + merged[pos:])
    print('merged', len(out), 'hunks')
else:
    sys.exit(1)

The repo's CLAUDE.md §12 and PRDs assume Windows (`Godot_v4.6.2-stable_win64_console.exe`, `%APPDATA%`, `tasklist`). On this Mac:

- **Godot binary:** `/Users/tugbauysal/Downloads/Godot.app/Contents/MacOS/Godot` (4.6.3 stable; the gopeak MCP uses the same path via `GODOT_PATH`). `export GODOT=...` before `tools/smoke_run.sh` / `tools/run_gate.sh` (their fallback only looks for `godot` on PATH or the Windows exe on Desktop).
- **`timeout` is missing on macOS** → `smoke_run.sh` fails with exit 127 "no verdict printed". Installed Homebrew `coreutils` (2026-10-10); put `export PATH="/opt/homebrew/opt/coreutils/libexec/gnubin:$PATH"` first. One smoke case ≈ 6 s.
- **Per-run user-dir isolation** (`APPDATA` on Windows) = give the Godot process its own `HOME`: `HOME="$(mktemp -d)" "$GODOT" --headless --path . ...` → `user://` lands under `<tmp>/Library/Application Support/Godot/app_userdata/Project Unicorn/` (verified with `--event-probe`).
- `pgrep -fl Godot` replaces `tasklist | grep -i godot`. Windowed `--*-shot` runs still need the display and run sequentially.
- First headless run on a fresh checkout: `"$GODOT" --headless --path . --import` (took ~1 min). Baseline at `bcb6a05`: `LINT PASS 0 error(s), 0 warning(s), 1 baselined, 94 card(s), 3 arc(s)`; `--event-probe` 159 passed.
- `git status` on this volume is extremely slow (10+ min, on-access scanning); `find -newer .git/refs/heads/main` is a fast proxy for "any local modifications". A stray `.git/refs/remotes/origin/main 2` file (macOS duplicate) broke `git fetch` ("bad object"); deleting it fixed fetch.

See [[project-unicorn-github-remote]] for repo layout and [[gopeak-runtime-verification-quirks]] for runtime driving.

The repo's CLAUDE.md §12 and PRDs assume Windows (`Godot_v4.6.2-stable_win64_console.exe`, `%APPDATA%`, `tasklist`). On this Mac:

- **Godot binary:** `/Users/tugbauysal/Downloads/Godot.app/Contents/MacOS/Godot` (4.6.3 stable; the gopeak MCP uses the same path via `GODOT_PATH`). `export GODOT=...` before `tools/smoke_run.sh` / `tools/run_gate.sh` (their fallback only looks for `godot` on PATH or the Windows exe on Desktop).
- **`timeout` is missing on macOS** → `smoke_run.sh` fails with exit 127 "no verdict printed". Installed Homebrew `coreutils` (2026-10-10); put `export PATH="/opt/homebrew/opt/coreutils/libexec/gnubin:$PATH"` first. One smoke case ≈ 6 s.
- **Per-run user-dir isolation** (`APPDATA` on Windows) = give the Godot process its own `HOME`: `HOME="$(mktemp -d)" "$GODOT" --headless --path . ...` → `user://` lands under `<tmp>/Library/Application Support/Godot/app_userdata/Project Unicorn/` (verified with `--event-probe`).
- `pgrep -fl Godot` replaces `tasklist | grep -i godot`. Windowed `--*-shot` runs still need the display and run sequentially.
- First headless run on a fresh checkout: `"$GODOT" --headless --path . --import` (took ~1 min). Baseline at `bcb6a05`: `LINT PASS 0 error(s), 0 warning(s), 1 baselined, 94 card(s), 3 arc(s)`; `--event-probe` 159 passed.
- `git status` on this volume is extremely slow (10+ min, on-access scanning); `find -newer .git/refs/heads/main` is a fast proxy for "any local modifications". A stray `.git/refs/remotes/origin/main 2` file (macOS duplicate) broke `git fetch` ("bad object"); deleting it fixed fetch.

See [[project-unicorn-github-remote]] for repo layout and [[gopeak-runtime-verification-quirks]] for runtime driving.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Smoke gate for the endgame suite.
#
# EndgameSmoke.run_case passes a case whose `-> String` body returned "". A GDScript runtime
# error inside a case either aborts the body (returning "") or continues with a null value,
# so a throwing case prints SMOKE PASS while proving nothing. GDScript cannot catch this
# in-process (no try/catch, no error hook), so the gate lives here: a case whose output
# carries an engine error token FAILS regardless of what it returned.
#
# The flag must NOT sit behind a `--` separator: main.gd reads OS.get_cmdline_args(), and
# args after `--` never reach it — the process boots the game and hangs.
#
#   tools/smoke_run.sh <case_id>      run one case
#   tools/smoke_run.sh --all          run every case in the match table
#   GODOT=/path/to/godot tools/smoke_run.sh ...
#
# Exit: 0 all green · 1 one or more cases failed · 2 harness problem.

set -uo pipefail

source "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/gate_common.sh"
SMOKE="$HERE/scripts/debug/endgame_smoke.gd"
CASE_TIMEOUT="${CASE_TIMEOUT:-120}"
[ -f "$SMOKE" ] || { echo "smoke_run: cannot find $SMOKE" >&2; exit 2; }

# The case list is the match table itself, so the runner can never drift from the suite.
list_cases() {
  awk '/^\tmatch case_name:/{on=1;next} on&&/^\t\t_:/{exit} on' "$SMOKE" \
    | grep -oE '^\s*"[a-z0-9_]+":' | tr -d '\t ":'
}

# A case that breaks a rule on purpose says `# EXPECT-ERROR <message fragment>` on its match arm.
expected_error() {
  awk -v id="\"$1\":" '/^\tmatch case_name:/{on=1;next} on&&/^\t\t_:/{exit}
    on&&$1==id&&/# EXPECT-ERROR /{sub(/.*# EXPECT-ERROR /,"");print;exit}' "$SMOKE" | tr -d '\r'
}

run_one() {
  local case_id="$1" log want
  log="$(mktemp)"
  want="$(expected_error "$case_id")"
  timeout "$CASE_TIMEOUT" "$GODOT" --path "$HERE" --headless --endgame-smoke="$case_id" >"$log" 2>&1
  local ex=$? verdict hits
  verdict="$(grep -aoE "SMOKE (PASS|FAIL).*" "$log" | head -1 | tr -d "\r")"
  hits="$(engine_errors "$log")"
  # grep -v '' would drop every line, so only a declared fragment is exempt.
  [ -z "$want" ] || hits="$(grep -avF -- "$want" <<<"$hits")"

  if [ -n "$hits" ]; then
    echo "SMOKE FAIL $case_id: $(wc -l <<<"$hits") engine error line(s) — a throwing case is not a passing case"
    head -3 <<<"$hits" | sed 's/^/    /'
    rm -f "$log"; return 1
  fi
  if [ "$ex" -eq 124 ]; then
    echo "SMOKE FAIL $case_id: timed out after ${CASE_TIMEOUT}s"; rm -f "$log"; return 1
  fi
  if [ -z "$verdict" ]; then
    echo "SMOKE FAIL $case_id: no verdict printed (exit $ex)"; rm -f "$log"; return 1
  fi
  if [ -n "$want" ] && ! grep -aqF -- "$want" "$log"; then
    echo "SMOKE FAIL $case_id: EXPECT-ERROR '$want' never printed (stale marker)"; rm -f "$log"; return 1
  fi
  echo "$verdict"
  rm -f "$log"
  case "$verdict" in "SMOKE PASS"*) return 0 ;; *) return 1 ;; esac
}

if [ "${1:---all}" = "--all" ]; then
  pass=0; fail=0; failed=()
  while read -r c; do
    [ -z "$c" ] && continue
    if run_one "$c"; then pass=$((pass+1)); else fail=$((fail+1)); failed+=("$c"); fi
  done < <(list_cases)
  echo "----"
  echo "SMOKE SUMMARY ${pass}/$((pass+fail)) passed"
  [ "$fail" -gt 0 ] && { printf 'FAILED: %s\n' "${failed[*]}"; exit 1; }

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Smoke gate for the endgame suite.
#
# EndgameSmoke.run_case passes a case whose `-> String` body returned "". A GDScript runtime
# error inside a case either aborts the body (returning "") or continues with a null value,
# so a throwing case prints SMOKE PASS while proving nothing. GDScript cannot catch this
# in-process (no try/catch, no error hook), so the gate lives here: a case whose output
# carries an engine error token FAILS regardless of what it returned.
#
# The flag must NOT sit behind a `--` separator: main.gd reads OS.get_cmdline_args(), and
# args after `--` never reach it — the process boots the game and hangs.
#
#   tools/smoke_run.sh <case_id>      run one case
#   tools/smoke_run.sh --all          run every case in the match table
#   GODOT=/path/to/godot tools/smoke_run.sh ...
#
# Exit: 0 all green · 1 one or more cases failed · 2 harness problem.

set -uo pipefail

source "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/gate_common.sh"
SMOKE="$HERE/scripts/debug/endgame_smoke.gd"
CASE_TIMEOUT="${CASE_TIMEOUT:-120}"
[ -f "$SMOKE" ] || { echo "smoke_run: cannot find $SMOKE" >&2; exit 2; }

# The case list is the match table itself, so the runner can never drift from the suite.
list_cases() {
  awk '/^\tmatch case_name:/{on=1;next} on&&/^\t\t_:/{exit} on' "$SMOKE" \
    | grep -oE '^\s*"[a-z0-9_]+":' | tr -d '\t ":'
}

# A case that breaks a rule on purpose says `# EXPECT-ERROR <message fragment>` on its match arm.
expected_error() {
  awk -v id="\"$1\":" '/^\tmatch case_name:/{on=1;next} on&&/^\t\t_:/{exit}
    on&&$1==id&&/# EXPECT-ERROR /{sub(/.*# EXPECT-ERROR /,"");print;exit}' "$SMOKE" | tr -d '\r'
}

run_one() {
  local case_id="$1" log want
  log="$(mktemp)"
  want="$(expected_error "$case_id")"
  timeout "$CASE_TIMEOUT" "$GODOT" --path "$HERE" --headless --endgame-smoke="$case_id" >"$log" 2>&1
  local ex=$? verdict hits
  verdict="$(grep -aoE "SMOKE (PASS|FAIL).*" "$log" | head -1 | tr -d "\r")"
  hits="$(engine_errors "$log")"
  # grep -v '' would drop every line, so only a declared fragment is exempt.
  [ -z "$want" ] || hits="$(grep -avF -- "$want" <<<"$hits")"

  if [ -n "$hits" ]; then
    echo "SMOKE FAIL $case_id: $(wc -l <<<"$hits") engine error line(s) — a throwing case is not a passing case"
    head -3 <<<"$hits" | sed 's/^/    /'
    rm -f "$log"; return 1
  fi
  if [ "$ex" -eq 124 ]; then
    echo "SMOKE FAIL $case_id: timed out after ${CASE_TIMEOUT}s"; rm -f "$log"; return 1
  fi
  if [ -z "$verdict" ]; then
    echo "SMOKE FAIL $case_id: no verdict printed (exit $ex)"; rm -f "$log"; return 1
  fi
  if [ -n "$want" ] && ! grep -aqF -- "$want" "$log"; then
    echo "SMOKE FAIL $case_id: EXPECT-ERROR '$want' never printed (stale marker)"; rm -f "$log"; return 1
  fi
  echo "$verdict"
  rm -f "$log"
  case "$verdict" in "SMOKE PASS"*) return 0 ;; *) return 1 ;; esac
}

if [ "${1:---all}" = "--all" ]; then
  pass=0; fail=0; failed=()
  while read -r c; do
    [ -z "$c" ] && continue
    if run_one "$c"; then pass=$((pass+1)); else fail=$((fail+1)); failed+=("$c"); fi
  done < <(list_cases)
  echo "----"
  echo "SMOKE SUMMARY ${pass}/$((pass+fail)) passed"
  [ "$fail" -gt 0 ] && { printf 'FAILED: %s\n' "${failed[*]}"; exit 1; }
  exit 0
fi

run_one "$1"

# Shared by smoke_run.sh and run_gate.sh; sourced, runs nothing but the Godot lookup.
#
# ERR_TOKENS is what makes a Godot run "carry an error": a GDScript runtime or parse failure,
# or any line of the engine's ERROR channel (push_error, failed resource loads), which prints
# as "ERROR: ..." at column 0. WARNING lines are not gated. ERR_IGNORE is the engine's
# shutdown leak report, which the same code prints in some runs and not in others.

HERE="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
ERR_TOKENS='^ERROR:|SCRIPT ERROR|Parse Error|Compile Error'
ERR_IGNORE='resources still in use at exit'

# The error lines of the Godot log in $1, carriage returns stripped.
engine_errors() { grep -aE "$ERR_TOKENS" "$1" | grep -avF -- "$ERR_IGNORE" | tr -d '\r'; }

if [ -z "${GODOT:-}" ]; then
  for c in "$(command -v godot || true)" \
           "$HOME/Desktop/Godot_v4.6.2-stable_win64_console.exe"; do
    [ -n "$c" ] && [ -x "$c" ] && GODOT="$c" && break
  done
fi
[ -n "${GODOT:-}" ] || { echo "${0##*/}: no Godot binary; set GODOT=<path>" >&2; exit 2; }

5	# metni), durum yuvası (söz tarihi, devreden ya da yetişmez) ve PM ya da soru yuvası. Sağda zaman ekseni: aşama çubukları (önden
6	# bitmiş aşamanın tik kutusu çubuğun başında), beklemeler, PM'in gölgesi ve kurucunun görüşme günleri, sprint dışına kalan pay
7	# turuncu taramalı. Satır modelin kartını ve zaman ekseni kaydını çizer; hesap yapmaz. Koşan sprintte saat ilerleyince `set_now`
8	# çubukların hâlini, dolgusunu ve çalışanların yüzlerini saklanan parçalardan yeniden okur. Art arda önden biten aşamalar tek tik
9	# kutusudur (son bitenin renginde; bitmiş aşamaların listesi kartın `stages`ında kalır). Her öğe kendi Control'üdür: çubuk,
10	# bekleme, gölge, tarama ve tik kutusu `StagePaint`, çip ve yuvalar kendi Label ya da Panel'i; ipucu o öğeye bağlanır. Zengin kart
11	# ipucu (`CardTip`) yalnız kartın adında açılır; çubuğun ipucu düz yazıdır ve açılırken okunur (koşan sprintte saat ilerler).
12	# Başlamayacak kartın (kapısı kapanmış) ipucu satırın kendisindedir, adın üstünde de o okunur: kapının gerekçesi ve kartın sonraki
13	# sütuna geçeceği.

310	func _x(week: float) -> float:
311		return roundf(week * UiTokens.D_W_TIMELINE / UiTokens.D_TIMELINE_WEEKS)

314	## Kartın aşamaları eksende: bekleme noktalı çizgisi, çubuk, sprint dışına kalan pay ve PM'in gölgesi. Eksenden önce ya da önden
315	## bitmiş aşama çizilmez: art arda bitenler tek tik kutusudur, son bitenin renginde, sonraki çubuğun başına takılır (arkasında çubuk
316	## yoksa tek başına). Sprint dışına kalan paylar arka arkaya durur: sonraki aşamanın payı öncekinin bittiği yerden başlar, eksenin
317	## sonunda kesilir.
318	func _lane(h: int) -> Control:
319		var lane := Control.new()
320		lane.position = Vector2(UiTokens.D_W_CARD_INFO, 0.0)
321		lane.size = Vector2(UiTokens.D_W_TIMELINE, h)
322		lane.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
323		var top: float = (h - UiTokens.D_H_STAGE_BAR) / 2.0
324		var shadows: Array = []
325		var waits: Array = []
326		var bars: Array = []
327		var ticks: Array = []
328		var out_end := 0.0
329		for s: Dictionary in card.stages:
330			if SprintUiShared.stage_done(s):
331				ticks.append(s)
332				continue
333			for wait: Dictionary in s.waits:
334				var from: float = _x(wait.from)
335				var width: float = _x(minf(wait.to, UiTokens.D_TIMELINE_WEEKS)) - from
336				if width >= 1.0:
337					var gap: StagePaint = StagePaint.part(&"wait", s.stage, {"from": wait.from, "to": wait.to, "person": wait.person, "role": wait.role},
338						Rect2(from, top + (UiTokens.D_H_STAGE_BAR - UiTokens.D_H_WAIT) / 2.0, width, UiTokens.D_H_WAIT))
339					gap.tooltip_text = _wait_tip(wait)
340					waits.append(gap)
341			if s.start >= 0.0:
342				var left: float = _x(s.start)
343				bars.append(_bar(s, Rect2(left, top, maxf(_x(s.end) - left, UiTokens.D_W_STAGE_BAR_LEAST), UiTokens.D_H_STAGE_BAR), "in", ticks))
344				ticks = []
345				var shade: StagePaint = _shadow(s, top)
346				if shade != null:
347					shadows.append(shade)
348			if s.out_from >= 0.0:
349				var out_left: float = maxf(_x(s.out_from), out_end)
350				var out_right: float = minf(out_left + _x(s.out_to) - _x(s.out_from), UiTokens.D_W_TIMELINE)
351				if out_right - out_left >= 1.0:
352					bars.append(_bar(s, Rect2(out_left, top, out_right - out_left, UiTokens.D_H_STAGE_BAR), "out", ticks))
353					ticks = []
354					out_end = out_right
355		if not ticks.is_empty():
356			bars.append(_tick(ticks, Rect2(0.0, top, UiTokens.D_W_TICK_BOX, UiTokens.D_H_STAGE_BAR)))
357		for part: Control in shadows + waits + bars:
358			lane.add_child(part)
359		if _ctx.mode == "active":
360			set_now(_ctx.now)
361		return lane

364	## Art arda biten aşamaların tek tik kutusu, son bitenin renginde; ipucu hangi aşamaların bittiğini satır satır yazar.
365	func _tick(ticks: Array, rect: Rect2) -> StagePaint:
366		var box: StagePaint = StagePaint.part(&"tick", ticks.back().stage, {}, rect)
367		box.tooltip_text = "\n".join(ticks.map(func(s: Dictionary) -> String:
368			return SprintUiShared.SEP.join([SprintUiShared.stage_name(s.stage), SprintUiShared.done_text(s)])))
369		return box

372	## Bir aşamanın çubuğu: zemini, bitmiş aşamaların tik kutusu (`ticks`, art arda bitenler), görüşme taramaları, ikon ve sayı,
373	## çalışanların yüzleri. `piece` "in" sprintin içindeki çubuk, "out" sprint dışına kalan pay.
374	func _bar(s: Dictionary, rect: Rect2, piece: String, ticks: Array) -> StagePaint:
375		var running: bool = _ctx.mode == "active"
376		var candidate: bool = _ctx.candidate
377		var out: bool = piece == "out"
378		var state: String = "ghost" if candidate else ("out" if out else "plan")
379		var total: float = s.pre + s.need
380		var main: String = str(roundi(s.out if out else s.in_sprint - s.done0))
381		var sub := ""
382		var fill := 0.0
383		if not out and s.pre > SprintSystem.EPS and not running:
384			main = str(roundi(s.pre))

387		var bar: StagePaint = StagePaint.part(&"bar", s.stage, {"state": state, "late": card.late, "fill": fill,
388			"from": s.out_from if out else s.start, "to": s.out_to if out else s.end, "piece": piece}, rect)
389		bar.clip_contents = true
390		if candidate:
391			bar.modulate.a = UiTokens.D_GHOST_ALPHA
392		if not ticks.is_empty():
393			bar.add_child(_tick(ticks, Rect2(0.0, 0.0, UiTokens.D_W_TICK_BOX, rect.size.y)))
394		if not out and not candidate:
395			for m: Dictionary in s.meet:
396				var from: float = maxf(_x(m.from), rect.position.x)
397				var to: float = minf(_x(m.to), rect.end.x)
398				if to - from >= 1.0:
399					var scan: StagePaint = StagePaint.part(&"meet", s.stage, m, Rect2(from - rect.position.x, 0.0, to - from, rect.size.y))
400					scan.tooltip_text = "\n".join(SprintUiShared.meet_lines(m.kinds))
401					bar.add_child(scan)
402		var left: float = UiTokens.D_W_TICK_BOX + UiTokens.SPACE_S if not ticks.is_empty() else float(UiTokens.D_STAGE_BAR_PAD.x)
403		var label: StagePaint = StagePaint.part(&"label", s.stage, {"state": state, "late": card.late, "main": main, "sub": sub, "left": left,
404			"room": 0.0, "icon": SprintUiShared.stage_icon(s.stage)}, Rect2(Vector2.ZERO, rect.size))
405		bar.add_child(label)
406		var faces := SprintUiShared.box(-UiTokens.SPACE_S)

410		bar.tip = _bar_tip.bind(entry)

413			_live.append(entry)

419	## Çubuğun ipucu, açılırken okunur: "{aşama} · efor {n}" ve durum parçaları: önden yapılan pay, hazırlanmasaydı efor, sprint dışına
420	## kalan pay, çalışanlar (koşarken o an çalışanlar); sprintin içindeki çubukta kurucunun görüşme kalemleri ayrı satırlarda.
421	func _bar_tip(entry: Dictionary) -> String:
422		var s: Dictionary = entry.stage
423		var out: bool = entry.out
424		var total: float = s.pre + s.need
425		var effort: String = str(roundi(s.out if out else total))
426		var working: Array = []
427		if _ctx.mode == "active" and not out:
428			working = entry.workers.filter(func(w: Dictionary) -> bool: return w.from <= _now and _now < w.to).map(
429				func(w: Dictionary) -> String: return w.id)
430			if s.start - SprintSystem.EPS <= _now and _now < s.end - SprintSystem.EPS:
431				effort = "%d/%d" % [floori(s.pre + SprintTimeline.done_at(s, _now) + SprintSystem.EPS), roundi(total)]
432		var parts: PackedStringArray = [SprintUiShared.stage_name(s.stage), SprintUiShared.effort_tip(effort)]
433		if not out and s.pre > SprintSystem.EPS:
434			parts.append(tr("PRODUCT_STAGE_READY").format({"pct": Fmt.percent(s.pre / total * 100.0, 0)}))
435		if card.pm != null and s.need_raw > s.need + SprintSystem.EPS:
436			parts.append(tr("PRODUCT_STAGE_RAW").format({"n": roundi(s.need_raw)}))
437		if out:
438			parts.append(tr("PRODUCT_STAGE_OUT"))
439		if not working.is_empty():
440			parts.append(tr("PRODUCT_STAGE_NOW").format({"names": ", ".join(_names(working))}))
441		elif not s.people.is_empty():
442			parts.append(", ".join(_names(s.people)))
443		var lines: PackedStringArray = [SprintUiShared.SEP.join(parts)]
444		if not out:
445			lines.append_array(SprintUiShared.meet_lines_of([s]))
446		return "\n".join(lines)

449	## Kişilerin tam adları (aynı adlı iki kişi böyle ayrılır).
450	func _names(ids: Array) -> Array:
451		return ids.map(func(id: String) -> String: return CharacterRegistry.get_character(id).character_name)
452	
453	
454	## Beklemenin ipucu: kimi beklediği ve o kişi o an hangi kartın hangi aşamasındaysa ("Bekliyor: Ayşe Kaya (Fatura · Geliştirme)");
455	## aşamada kimse yoksa rolün çoğulu (araştırmada ürün yöneticisi ya da kurucu).
456	func _wait_tip(wait: Dictionary) -> String:
457		if wait.person == "":
458			return tr(WAIT_KEYS[wait.role])
459		var who: String = CharacterRegistry.get_character(wait.person).character_name
460		if not wait.busy.is_empty():
461			who += " (" + SprintUiShared.SEP.join([SprintCatalog.card_name(SprintCatalog.card_by_id(wait.busy.card)),
462				SprintUiShared.stage_name(wait.busy.stage)]) + ")"
463		return tr("PRODUCT_WAIT_FOR").format({"name": who})

466	## PM'in kısalttığı payın gölgesi: çubuğun altında, çubuğun başından hazırlanmasaydı biteceği yere uzanan şerit. Hazırlanmamış
467	## hâlin ek süresi, ek işin son parçanın hızına bölünmesidir.
468	func _shadow(s: Dictionary, top: float) -> StagePaint:
469		if card.pm == null or s.need_raw <= s.need + SprintSystem.EPS or s.pieces.is_empty():
470			return null
471		var last: Dictionary = s.pieces[-1]
472		var pace: float = float(last.work) / maxf(last.to - last.from, SprintSystem.EPS)
473		var from: float = _x(s.pieces[0].from)
474		var to: float = minf(_x(float(last.to) + (s.need_raw - s.need) / pace), UiTokens.D_W_TIMELINE)
475		if to - from < 1.0:
476			return null
477		var shade: StagePaint = StagePaint.part(&"shadow", s.stage, {}, Rect2(from + UiTokens.D_SHADOW_INSET,
478			top + UiTokens.D_H_STAGE_BAR - UiTokens.BORDER_HAIRLINE, to - from - UiTokens.D_SHADOW_INSET, UiTokens.D_H_SHADOW))
479		shade.tooltip_text = tr("PRODUCT_STAGE_SHADOW").format({"stage": SprintUiShared.stage_name(s.stage), "before": roundi(s.need_raw),
480			"now": roundi(s.need)})
481		return shade

484	## Planlamada kurucunun çalıştığı çubuğun ucunda yüzü; çubuk sığmıyorsa çizilmez.
485	func _founder_face(entry: Dictionary) -> void:
486		var s: Dictionary = entry.stage
487		for id: String in s.people:
488			if _ctx.people.has(id):
489				_faces(entry, [id], true)
490	
491	
492	## Çubuğa `ids` kişilerinin yüzleri (kurucu halkalı) sağ uca konur ve etiket onlara yer ayırır; çubuk sığmıyorsa yüz çizilmez.
493	func _faces(entry: Dictionary, ids: Array, planned := false) -> void:
494		var faces: HBoxContainer = entry.faces
495		UiFactory.clear(faces)
496		var bar: StagePaint = entry.ground
497		var face_px: int = UiTokens.D_AVATAR_ROW_SM
498		var width: float = ids.size() * (face_px - UiTokens.SPACE_S) + UiTokens.SPACE_S
499		var text_w: float = StagePaint.text_width(String(entry.main) + String(entry.sub))
500		var room: float = 0.0
501		var need: float = float(entry.left) + UiTokens.D_ICON_TAG + UiTokens.SPACE_S + text_w + width + UiTokens.SPACE_S + UiTokens.D_STAGE_BAR_PAD.y
502		if not ids.is_empty() and bar.size.x >= (need if planned else width + float(entry.left) + UiTokens.D_STAGE_BAR_PAD.y):
503			for id: String in ids:
504				faces.add_child(SprintUiShared.face(_ctx.people[id], face_px, false, false))
505			faces.position = Vector2(bar.size.x - UiTokens.D_STAGE_BAR_PAD.y - width, (bar.size.y - face_px) / 2.0)
506			room = width + UiTokens.SPACE_S
507		(entry.label as StagePaint).set_bar({"room": room})
508	
509	
510	func _workers(s: Dictionary) -> Array:
511		var out: Array = []
512		for id: String in _ctx.people:
513			for p: Dictionary in _ctx.people[id].pieces:
514				if p.card == card.id and p.stage == s.stage and not p.ahead and p.to > s.start and p.from < s.end:
515					out.append({"id": id, "from": p.from, "to": p.to})
516		return out
